tables.label: Table 1
tables.caption: Synergistic effect of C14R and fluconazole against clinical isolates of Candida albicans and Candida auris from Colombia resistant to fluconazole.
footnotes: FIC, fractional inhibitory concentration; FCZ, fluconazole.
Minimal inhibitory concentration (MIC) values of C14R alone or in combination with fluconazole are shown, as well as the MIC values of fluconazole alone or in combination with C14R.
